description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'CommandNotSupportedException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an error scenario where a command is not supported by a specific API version. The class includes static factory methods, a builder pattern, and is annotated for immutability and JSON parsing.

classes.name: CommandNotSupportedException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException, representing an unsupported command error with factory methods and a nested builder class.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, mutable builder class providing a fluent API to construct instances of CommandNotSupportedException, with support for setting headers, message, description, cause, and link (href).

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an instance of CommandNotSupportedException with a custom message and command headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of CommandNotSupportedException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to create a new exception instance with updated headers.
